note: `totalTestOrder d g` is (2+Σd)*g.card, which is [M]'s (2+|A|_deg)n when g is the full index set. [L] states it for arbitrary collision groups and for the major kernel, so it is more general, and the order is stated for all compacts at once.

lemma global_charge {o : Points k} (h : plane g ≤ LinearMap.range P.toLinearMap) (hp : Collapsed g o) (t : Cells S d) (α : Viewers Z){s B : ℝ} (hb : B∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1) (hz : B ≤ M.clearance (∑ i,d i+0)) (hh : 0<s ∧ 2*s ≤ B) (H : Services C F S): Charge (majorKernel P g M t α o s) ⊤ (totalTestOrder d g):= by
   constructor; intro K hK; obtain ⟨A,hA,hg⟩:= glues_total M H t α h hp K.isCompact hb hz hh; exact ⟨A,hA, fun i _ hm h=>hg i _ hm h⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `global_charge` gives a `Charge` of order `totalTestOrder d g` for `majorKernel` on every compact set, via `glues_total`.

structure Charge (P : E→ SmoothTests E→ₗ[ℂ] X)(U : Opens E)(n : ℕ) : Prop where
   cost : ∀ K:Compacts E, (K:Set E) ⊆ U → ∃ C> (0:ℝ),∀ (p:SmoothTests E){m:ℝ}, tsupport p.val ⊆ K → Jet n univ p.val m → Dust (fun x=> P x p) (C*m)

proof_context.conclusion: `Charge` says that on each compact K there is C>0 with the integral bounded by C times the sup-norm jet of order n on test functions supported in K.

proof_context.conclusion: The `distribution` field of `MultipleLight` asserts this charge of order `totalTestOrder d g` for every group and slice.
